'''''Quality & Quantity''''' is a [[double-blind]] [[peer-reviewed]] [[academic journal]] dealing with [[methodology|methodological issues]] in the fields of [[economics]], [[psychology]] and [[sociology|sociology, mathematics, and statistics]]. The journal is published by [[Springer Science+Business Media]].
